evals.name: generate-homepage
evals.prompt: Generate src/pages/index.astro for a homepage. Design brief: page type 'homepage' with sections: hero (heading, subheading, cta), features (3 items grid). Shared components: Header, Footer. Template is at template/astro-project/. Output directory: output/test-site/
evals.expected_output: A valid src/pages/index.astro file that imports Layout, wraps content in Layout component, includes Hero section with heading/subheading/cta, and includes Features grid section.

assertions.name: file-created
assertions.check: File src/pages/index.astro exists in output directory

assertions.name: valid-astro-syntax
assertions.check: File has valid Astro frontmatter (--- fences)

evals.name: generate-component
evals.prompt: Generate src/components/Header.astro component. Design brief: shared component 'Header' with navigation menu (Home, About, Contact links). Use semantic HTML and Tailwind classes.
evals.expected_output: A valid src/components/Header.astro file with header element, logo/title, and navigation links. Uses Tailwind classes for styling.

assertions.name: has-navigation
assertions.check: File has navigation links (nav or anchor tags)

evals.name: generate-layout
evals.prompt: Generate src/layouts/Layout.astro. Should include HTML shell, head with meta tags, import globals.css, include Header and Footer components, and have a slot for page content.
evals.expected_output: A valid src/layouts/Layout.astro with proper HTML structure, DOCTYPE, head element with viewport meta, body with bg-background text-foreground classes, imports globals.css, includes Header/Footer, and has <slot />.

assertions.name: body-classes
assertions.check: Body element has bg-background and text-foreground classes

evals.name: shadcn-integration
evals.prompt: Generate src/components/FeatureCard.astro that uses Shadcn Card component. Design brief: component uses Card from Shadcn, displays title and description. Install Card component first if needed.
evals.expected_output: A valid src/components/FeatureCard.astro that imports Card from @/components/ui/card, uses Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription components properly.

assertions.name: no-client-directive
assertions.check: Static Card component does NOT have client directive (Card is static)
